name: Chunk
lead: A 16 by 16 column of blocks, handed to `world.on_generate`, `world.on_populate` and a room's `generate` to fill.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Chunk X coordinate (16 blocks each). Chunk Z coordinate (16 blocks each). The chunk's lowest corner, inclusive; y runs 0..255 or the game version's height. The chunk's highest corner, inclusive. Returns the block there now, by name; air outside the chunk.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Sets one block; positions outside the chunk are ignored.

functions.name: fill
functions.signature: chunk:fill(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, block: string)
functions.description: Fills a box of blocks, clipped to the chunk.

functions.name: paste
functions.signature: chunk:paste(schem: Schematic, origin: Vec3, opts: { air: boolean ?, part: string ? }?)
functions.description: Clipped to this chunk; air is skipped unless `air` is true. `part` names the paste for `citadel render --part` and `citadel check`; the build's own `b:part`s are then inside it ("house/roof").

functions.name: get_biome
functions.description: Returns the biome of the column at `pos`, by name; `nil` outside the chunk. A biome belongs to a column, so `pos.y` is not read.

functions.name: set_biome
functions.description: Sets the biome of one column: a vanilla name ("desert") or the name `game.biomes.define` returned.

functions.name: fill_biome
functions.signature: chunk:fill_biome(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, biome: string)
functions.description: Sets the biome of every column in a box, clipped to the chunk.
